from pathlib import Path
import collections
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f023d60d.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    proto = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (background, marker)]
    if not proto:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in proto); r1 = max(r for r, c, v in proto)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in proto); c1 = max(c for r, c, v in proto)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == marker:
                out[r][c] = background
                for pr, pc, color in proto:
                    rr, cc = r + pr - ar, c + pc - ac
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
